question: Should the official MiniMax API-key path switch to X-Api-Key and migrate existing official-endpoint profiles despite current vendor documentation describing Bearer authentication?
rationale: The linked production report supports the reported regression, but the proposed global default and migration conflict with the available vendor contract; only maintainers or vendor-backed live evidence can safely settle that external API behavior.

options.title: Require endpoint-contract proof before merge
options.body: Capture redacted successful requests for the affected official global and China API-key endpoints, or obtain an authoritative MiniMax confirmation, then align the default and Doctor migration to that contract.

options.title: Preserve Bearer pending vendor clarification
options.body: Keep the current API-key behavior and pursue a narrower configuration-specific repair only after the affected key type and endpoint contract are established.

recommendation.title: Require endpoint-contract proof before merge
recommendation.body: Capture redacted successful requests for the affected official global and China API-key endpoints, or obtain an authoritative MiniMax confirmation, then align the default and Doctor migration to that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior MiniMax Portal OAuth work is the closest visible ownership signal for the authentication split under review.
